lifecycle.reason: The declared cosine window attention core includes learned logit scaling and relative position bias and has no single-call equivalent library path.

publication.note: Static migration is complete; full oracle replay plus refreshed MUSA correctness and timing evidence are still required before release.

target_environment.note: The task names the environment it was measured in and leaves device and component details in that record. Latencies are comparable only within one snapshot_id.

golden_oracle.note: Independent CPU oracle: the framework exports only deterministically initialized public constructor state; patch embedding, all blocks, attention, merging, pooling and classification are evaluated with NumPy float64 arithmetic.

tensor_contract.note: float32 only. Public smoke cases use B=1..3; B=4 remains inside the contract but is reserved for the non-overlapping hidden shape domain.

submission.note: A Python module defining ModelNew, with no library compute in the declared attention core.

kernel_scope.enforced_note: The audit rejects a fused attention entry point. The must/may lists below define the boundary for surrounding framework operations.
must_be_in_kernel: cosine normalisation and learned logit scale
kernel_scope.note: The scored output is the full four-stage classifier, while the declared implementation target is every window-attention core, including the bias and shift-mask paths.

scoring.ranking: A-kernel track only; never merged or averaged with the B-library track

denominator_policy.fallback_condition: only when exact semantic equivalence is established and upstream_musa is unavailable or degenerate

build.note: The static audit runs before compilation, so a rejected submission never spends a compile.

self_test.note: Runs without a device: case coverage, independent-golden integrity and source audit.

abi.inputs: in-process torch tensors generated from the declared case contract
abi.transport: Python ModelNew invocation in the evaluator process
abi.runner: musa_operator_eval/evaluator/run_task.py, which imports torch through the framework evaluator
